statements.markdown:
**Lemma 11.3 (The terminal bound at square depths).** *Let $A\subseteq\mathbb{N}$ with $1\notin A$ and $X_{A}(2)=1/2$. Then for every $k\ge1$,*
$$
\bigl(\operatorname{ihc}\ A\ (k^{2}-1)\ :\ \mathbb{R}\bigr)
\ =\ \mathtt{binaryCoeffTail}\ (c_{A})\ (k^{2})
\ \le\ 2k+4\ =\ B\ (k^{2}).
$$
